question: Can residual shell-tail freedom on h_vec be eliminated by proving it is physically null for IO observables that read h_vec?

executive_verdict.summary: Scoped exhaustion closes for the current scalar-bridge quotient observable class. Universal all-future-observable exhaustion does not close.

definitions.name: Current Scalar-Bridge Quotient Observable
definitions.membership_test: Observable dependence on G^(1) enters only through B G^(1) B^dagger and, for the scalar-amplitude slot, through the Paper 31 rank-one active-line quotient.

definitions.name: Scalar-Bridge Residual
definitions.definition: A covariance difference DeltaG satisfying B DeltaG B^dagger = 0 on the gauge/null-reduced source carrier.

theorems.name: Bridge-Null Residuals Are Invisible to Scalar-Bridge Quotient Observables
theorems.claim: If two covariances have the same B G B^dagger compression, every observable in the current scalar-bridge quotient class has the same value on both.

theorems.name: Current Paper 27 Source-Side Scalar Inputs Belong to the Class
theorems.claim: The current Paper 27 scalar-source inputs that depend on h_vec belong to the current scalar-bridge quotient observable class.

theorems.name: Current Scalar-Bridge Observable Exhaustion
theorems.claim: For every current scalar-bridge quotient observable O and every residual DeltaG with B DeltaG B^dagger = 0, O(G+DeltaG)=O(G).

theorems.name: No Hidden Native A_s Fit Parameter
theorems.claim: Residual shell-tail freedom on h_vec cannot tune native A_s.

theorems.name: Universal All-Future-Observable Exhaustion No-Go
theorems.claim: Bridge-nullity for B G B^dagger does not imply nullity for every conceivable future observable on h_vec; higher-shell projectors or future polarization/non-Gaussian/vector diagnostics could separate residual shell tails unless an admissible-observable classification theorem excludes them.
chain: existence of higher-shell projectors in Omega^1_coex(S3)
standard operator algebra separation by linear functionals

remaining_frontier.candidate_statement: Every IO-admissible physical observable on h_vec either factors through the Paper 23 scalar bridge quotient, belongs to a separate carrier sector, is stress-energy/backreaction-forbidden by P1, is gauge/null, or is an imported exterior observable with a separately fixed state.

must_not_overclaim: Do not claim current scalar-bridge quotient exhaustion selects the full h_vec state.
Do not claim bridge-null residuals are null for all future observables.
Do not claim higher-shell residual functionals are excluded without a separate admissible-observable theorem.
Do not claim tensor, vector, polarization, or non-Gaussian observables are covered unless they factor through B G B^dagger.
